description: This source file defines the MenuSessionsInjector class responsible for injecting session and node information into an NSMenu in a macOS application. It manages cache updates, UI injection, menu interactions, and network/control channel state observations to dynamically build and update context menus related to user sessions and connected nodes.

classes.name: MenuSessionsInjector
classes.description: Manages the injection of session and node information into macOS menu items, observing control channel state, maintaining caches, and dynamically building menu UI components for active sessions and connected nodes.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up the injector into a specified NSStatusItem, replacing its menu delegate and initializing cache refresh and control channel observation.

methods.name: menuWillOpen
methods.description: Handles actions to perform right before the menu opens, including injecting session and node items and starting cache refresh tasks.

methods.name: menuDidClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup and cancelation of tasks when the menu closes.

methods.name: menuNeedsUpdate
methods.description: Placeholder for menu update handling, delegating to original delegate.

methods.name: confinementRect
methods.description: Determines the rectangle boundary for menu confinement, delegating to original delegate or returning zero rect.

methods.name: inject
methods.description: Builds and inserts dynamic session-related items into the menu.

methods.name: injectNodes
methods.description: Builds and inserts node-related items into the menu.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes session snapshot cache, with error handling.

methods.name: refreshUsageCache
methods.description: Refreshes usage summary cache asynchronously.

methods.name: refreshCostUsageCache
methods.description: Refreshes cost usage summary cache asynchronously.

methods.name: buildSubmenu
methods.description: Creates a detailed submenu for a session row, including recent messages, thinking/verbose levels, and control options.

methods.name: buildThinkingMenu
methods.description: Creates a menu for selecting session thinking levels.

methods.name: buildVerboseMenu
methods.description: Creates a menu for toggling session verbose output.

methods.name: buildPreviewSubmenu
methods.description: Creates a submenu showing recent messages preview for a session.

methods.name: buildNodesOverflowMenu
methods.description: Creates a submenu for additional node entries beyond the initial set.

methods.name: buildNodeSubmenu
methods.description: Creates a context menu with detailed information and actions for a specific node.

methods.name: makeNodeItem
methods.description: Creates a menu item representing a node entry, with associated actions and views.

methods.name: makeSessionPreviewItem
methods.description: Builds a menu item with a preview of recent session messages.

methods.name: compactError
methods.description: Produces a condensed string message from an error.

methods.name: compactUsageError
methods.description: Produces a condensed string message from a usage error.

methods.name: formatVersionLabel
methods.description: Formats version strings for display.
